description: Patch identity fields (legal/preferred name, pronouns, social handles, user_relationships[]). Never infer sensitive identity from appearance. Confirmed user_relationships are preserved unless force=true. ($0.10; API key required)

preferred_name.description: Name the person prefers to be called, e.g. Lex.

request_id.description: Client idempotency key (retries return original result).

social_handles.description: Map of platform to handle, e.g. {"instagram":"@alexc"}.

user_relationships.description: Relationship entries for the contact, e.g. [{"type":"sister"}].
